cases.prompt: 研究一下具身智能的发展脉络，从 Transformer 开始。请给我一份可供评审的中文报告。
review_focus: 技术路线是否解释了转折的原因和代价，而非只列论文时间线
关键论文和因果判断能否追溯到原始来源
报告是否帮助读者形成可用的领域理解

cases.prompt: 根据《π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control》原论文，报告图像编码、observation 前向、十次 flow 前向、板载总耗时、离板网络耗时和总耗时，并说明 20 Hz 与 50 Hz 机器人的再次推理周期及其控制含义。请标出硬件与相机条件，给我简短、可核查的中文说明。
review_focus: 区分十次 flow 前向、图像编码和机器人端总耗时
数字和硬件条件是否与原论文一致
实时性的推断是否有适当边界

required_facts.fact: Table I timings use an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 and three camera images.
Image encoders take 14 ms.
The observation forward pass takes 32 ms.
The ten action/flow forward passes together take 27 ms.
Total on-board inference time is 73 ms.
Off-board inference adds 13 ms of network latency and totals 86 ms.
The 20 Hz UR5e and Franka robots run inference every 0.8 seconds, after 16 actions.
Other robots running at 50 Hz run inference every 0.5 seconds, after 25 actions.

critical_errors.false_claim: The 27 ms for ten flow passes is the total robot-side inference time.
π0 recomputes an inference at every 20 Hz or 50 Hz control step.

cases.prompt: 根据《Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners: Extracting Actionable Knowledge for Embodied Agents》原论文，报告 Table 1 中 Vanilla Codex 12B 与完整 Translated Codex 12B 的可执行性和正确性，再列出 Table 2 中 Translated Codex 12B 去掉动作翻译、动态示例、轨迹修正时的可执行性。说明这些结果对方法归因的含义。请给我简短、可核查的中文说明。
review_focus: 不把完整方法的提升全归功于动作翻译一个组件
区分可执行性与正确性
数字和消融结论是否与原论文一致

required_facts.fact: Table 1 reports 18.07% executability for Vanilla Codex 12B.
Table 1 reports 78.57% executability for complete Translated Codex 12B.
Table 1 reports 64.87% correctness for Vanilla Codex 12B.
Table 1 reports 54.88% correctness for Translated Codex 12B.
Table 2 reports 31.49% executability for Translated Codex 12B without action translation.
Table 2 reports 50.86% executability without the dynamic example.
Table 2 reports 55.19% executability without trajectory correction.
Removing action translation causes the largest executability drop among the three listed Codex 12B ablations.

critical_errors.false_claim: The full method's executability increase from 18.07% to 78.57% measures the effect of action translation alone.
The reported executability increase also establishes an increase in correctness or unqualified overall quality.

cases.prompt: 请比较 MolmoAct（arXiv:2508.07917）与 Action Hallucination（arXiv:2602.06339）对 MolmoAct 动作生成架构的描述。根据 MolmoAct 原论文 §2.3 核实其动作表示与生成方式，并指出 Action Hallucination §1 的归类是否与原论文一致。提供简短、可核查的中文说明。
review_focus: 是否依据 MolmoAct 原论文核实其自回归动作 token 架构
是否将 Action Hallucination §1 对 MolmoAct 的条件流/扩散归类与原论文直接对照，并说明差异
是否点名被讨论的架构并给出可追溯的原文位置

required_facts.fact: MolmoAct §2.3 formulates visuomotor control as autoregressive sequence modeling and generates action tokens autoregressively.
Action Hallucination §1 groups MolmoAct with conditional flow/diffusion models for action trajectories.
Action Hallucination's classification conflicts with MolmoAct's own autoregressive action-token description.

critical_errors.false_claim: MolmoAct's own paper describes its action generation as conditional flow matching or diffusion.
The two papers give the same architecture description for MolmoAct.

cases.prompt: 请基于 RT-1（arXiv:2212.06817）、RT-2（arXiv:2307.15818）和 Embodied-R1.5（arXiv:2606.11324）原论文，梳理具身机器人闭环能力的演进，区分早期低层控制闭环与后来的任务层计划、监测和重规划，并核实闭环能力是否到 2025–26 年才出现。提供简短、可核查的中文说明。
review_focus: 是否用 RT-1 和 RT-2 原论文核实 2025 年前已有的低层视觉到动作闭环控制
是否把 Embodied-R1.5 的任务层计划、监测和重规划与低层控制闭环区分开
是否避免声称闭环能力直到 2025–26 年才出现，并为时间与能力范围提供原文位置

required_facts.fact: RT-1 states that it performs closed-loop robot control.
RT-2 describes robot actions as tokens that are decoded into actions for closed-loop control.
Embodied-R1.5 describes a planner-grounder-corrector loop that monitors execution and triggers retries or adaptive replanning after failure.
RT-1 and RT-2 already document closed-loop robot control before 2025; Embodied-R1.5's later task-level loop does not establish the first appearance of closed-loop control.
required_facts.source_section: RT-1 Section 4; compare RT-2 Introduction and Embodied-R1.5 Sections 2.1 and 5

critical_errors.false_claim: Closed-loop robot control first appeared in 2025–26.
Embodied-R1.5's task-level planning and correction loop is the same capability as RT-1/RT-2 low-level perception-to-action control.

cases.prompt: 我想理解优化器正则化方法为何从常见的 L2 penalty 写法发展到 AdamW。请根据《Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization》原论文，写一份约 800–1200 字、可供评审的中文短报告：说明 L2 penalty 与 decoupled weight decay 对标准 SGD 和 Adam 是否等价；若 SGD 下等价，指出系数如何随学习率缩放；解释 AdamW 改变了什么，以及论文实证收益的适用范围。
review_focus: 是否准确区分标准 SGD 与 Adam 下 L2 正则和 decoupled weight decay 的关系
是否说明 AdamW 将 weight decay 从自适应梯度更新中解耦
是否把论文的图像分类实验和作者说明的适用边界讲清楚

required_facts.fact: For standard SGD, L2 regularization and weight decay are equivalent when the coefficient is rescaled by the learning rate (lambda-prime = lambda / alpha in the paper's notation).
For Adam and adaptive gradients, L2 regularization and decoupled weight decay are not equivalent.
AdamW applies weight decay separately from the adaptive gradient update instead of adapting the L2 penalty as part of the loss gradient.
The paper's main AdamW generalization comparison is on image-classification datasets.
The conclusion says the image-classification results need verification on a wider range of tasks.

critical_errors.false_claim: L2 regularization and decoupled weight decay are equivalent for Adam or other adaptive gradient methods.
The paper establishes AdamW as universally superior across tasks or optimizers.

cases.prompt: 梳理自动驾驶方法从模块化感知、预测和规划，发展到端到端方法的技术脉络。请给我一份可供评审的中文报告，重点解释各阶段解决了什么问题、留下什么限制。
review_focus: 阶段划分是否服务于理解，而非只按年份罗列
代表性原始工作与效果边界是否可核查
是否说明模块化和端到端路线仍然并存的原因

cases.prompt: 我想理解 SQLite 的 WAL 如何改变读写并发，以及它付出的代价。请根据 SQLite 官方 Write-Ahead Logging 文档，写一份约 800–1200 字、可供评审的中文短报告：说明 WAL 模式下读写是否能并行、同时写入的限制、长读事务对 checkpoint 和 WAL 重置的影响，以及 WAL 对共享内存和网络文件系统的要求；说明文档记录的 SQLITE_BUSY 例外，避免将并发性质说成绝对保证。
review_focus: 是否说明 WAL 通常允许读者与写者并行，但同一时刻只有一个写者
是否说明长读事务可能阻止 checkpoint 完成并延后 WAL 重置
是否说明 WAL 需要同机共享内存、不能用于网络文件系统，并保留 SQLITE_BUSY 例外

required_facts.fact: WAL generally allows readers and a writer to proceed concurrently.
WAL mode permits only one writer at a time.
A long-running read transaction can prevent a checkpointer from making progress or completing its work.
A WAL reset requires the checkpoint to transfer and sync the full WAL and no readers to still be using it, so a long-running reader can delay reset.
WAL relies on shared memory among processes on the same host and does not work over a network filesystem.
SQLite documents situations in which queries in WAL mode can return SQLITE_BUSY.

critical_errors.false_claim: WAL mode allows multiple writers to write at the same time.
WAL mode works across a network filesystem.
WAL mode guarantees that operations never return SQLITE_BUSY.
